notes: Scraped from the Home Affairs skilled occupation list data feed (same data as the table at the source page) on 2026-10-15.

anzsco is the ANZSCO 2013 code (used for 189/190/491/494/485/407) when given, otherwise the ANZSCO 2022 code (CSOL-only rows, used for 186/482). anzsco2022 is the ANZSCO 2022 code where Home Affairs lists one.
unitGroup is the first 4 digits of anzsco.
visas lists subclass numbers Home Affairs shows for the occupation; 489 is a legacy subclass. "RSMS ROL" rows have no current visa listed.
caveats=true means Home Affairs lists caveats for at least one visa.
skillLevel is the ANZSCO 2022 skill level from the JSA 2025 Occupation Shortage List, matched on the ANZSCO 2022 code, or on the 2013 code only when the occupation title is identical; otherwise null.
Some ANZSCO codes appear twice (different 2013 vs 2022 titles, e.g. 332211 Painting Trades Worker / Painter).
